title: Strings that YAML 1.1 reads as timestamps, merge keys or values
refs: YAML 1.1 types (yaml.org/type): bool, int, float, timestamp, merge, value
notes: The Core schema reads these as strings. YAML 1.1 reads the first three as timestamps, `<<` as the merge key and `=` as the value key, so a plain one is not a string there. They are quoted. This is a writing convention of the family, not the specification: a string is written plain only when every common reader reads it as that same string, so the text is judged under the YAML 1.2 Core schema (loose) and also under YAML 1.1 and the number forms common readers accept (strict).
